shows.title: Fantasy Footballers - Fantasy Football Podcast
shows.description: Fantasy Football at its very best. Say goodbye to the talking heads of the Fantasy Football world and hello to The Fantasy Footballers. The expert trio of Andy Holloway, Jason Moore, and Mike "The Fantasy Hitman" Wright break down the world of Fantasy Football with astute analysis, strong opinions, and matchup-winning advice you can't get anywhere else. A high-quality and entertaining show that will win you your league -- in style. The ONE Fantasy Football Podcast you can't leave off your roster.

shows.title: The Dan Le Batard Show
shows.description: Live from the Elser Hotel in Downtown Miami, Dan Le Batard and company share their unique perspectives on all things sports, pop culture, and more. This is the place for original content from Le Batard's daily 3-hour live show, including the daily “Local Hour,” generally focusing on the South Florida scene and a few more surprises along the way.

shows.title: Pablo Torre Finds Out
shows.description: Follow Pablo down the rabbit hole, beyond the game — every Tuesday, Thursday and Friday — on his Pulitzer-winning video podcast, part of The Athletic Podcast Network. You’ll get a deep-dive "talkumentary" episode, reported by Pablo and Curiosity Correspondents like Emmy-winning comedian Wyatt Cenac and Oscar-winning director Ezra Edelman, answering urgent questions such as: Are you smarter than an NFL quarterback? Does Giannis intentionally miss free throws to win free chicken for fans? And why does the FBI director play so much hockey? This storytelling has been honored by the Pulitzer Prizes, the Emmy Awards, the Peabody Awards and the Edward R. Murrow Awards. (Journalism!) Plus: Pablo hangs out with handpicked figures from sports, culture and politics like Sue Bird, Action Bronson and U.S. Senators… plays Share & Tell with friends like Domonique Foxworth, Mina Kimes, Katie Nolan and Dan Le Batard (aka his boss)… and unveils the secrets of capitalism with David Samson and John Skipper on The Sporting Class. Follow PTFO… https://www.youtube.com/@PabloTorreFindsOut https://www.instagram.com/pablotorrefindsout https://x.com/pablofindsout and subscribe to Pablo's newsletter: https://pablo.show Hosted on Acast. shows.title: Is She Game?
shows.publisher: Higher Ground Network and Run A Muck
shows.description: "Is She Game?" is a hub for the ever-expanding, culture-shaping world of women’s sports – building community by serving fans and creating new ones. Each week, host Coach Jackie J breaks down this week’s news in sports and culture, hangs out with a special guest, and sets you up with moments to look forward to in the week to come. Jackie is the People’s Coach: teaching you all about women’s sports, so YOU TOO can have the time of your life as a fan of whatever sport catches your eye! From the WNBA to the rec rugby league your mom just joined, she has her finger on the pulse of sports worldwide. She can’t wait to turn you into a women’s sports fan. We love women’s sports!

shows.title: On The Line with Jim Pyne
shows.description: On the Line with Jim Pyne brings you authentic conversations with the leaders shaping sports, business, and entertainment. Hosted by former NFL player, coach, executive, entrepreneur, and Founder & CEO of PLS Aviation, Jim Pyne draws on decades of relationships to explore leadership, winning cultures, entrepreneurship, resilience, and the experiences that define extraordinary careers. From championship coaches and elite athletes to CEOs and innovators, each episode delivers candid insights and practical lessons from people who have performed at the highest levels. Leadership. Relationships. Success.
